official.deadline_note: No separate institutional deadline is published. The call is two-stage: stage 1, the submission of research projects and their directors by FCM teacher-researchers, ran from 5 to 16 October 2026 and admitted projects are circulating from 2 to 6 November 2026; stage 2, student registration, runs from 9 to 20 November 2026. Students can only apply once the admitted projects have been published. Definitive awards are expected in December 2026 and the scholarships begin on 1 February 2027.
official.application_cycle: Convocatoria 2026-2027 (call presented to the FCM community 28 September to 2 October 2026)
official.status_note: The official announcement of 28 September 2026 states that the 2026-2027 call of the Programa de Becas de Investigacion para Estudiantes is open. The first stage (projects and directors) ran 5-16 October 2026, admitted projects and directors are being circulated 2-6 November 2026, student registration runs 9-20 November 2026, student evaluation 30 November to 11 December 2026 and definitive awards are scheduled for December 2026, with scholarships starting 1 February 2027.
benefits: 20 research scholarships are awarded in the 2026-2027 call, each for a total of $151.637,14
210 clock hours of formative experience: a 10-hour Curso de Metodologia de la Investigacion plus 200 hours of project execution, over a maximum of six consecutive months
Payment in two instalments: 70% at the start of the project (8-12 February 2027) and the remaining 30% once the director's closing report is approved
The Faculty also covers the insurance costs of the scholarship holder
Individual applicants need no prior research team or supervisor: they choose from the list of already-admitted projects and directors
Students who reach the minimum 60 points but are not awarded a scholarship may be given an aval academico to complete the same formative experience, without a stipend
eligibility: Regular students of Medicina, Licenciatura en Enfermeria and Tecnicos Asistenciales en Salud at the FCM UNCUYO who have passed at least the first complete year of the degree
Applicants must declare that they have the time availability to develop the project on the days and hours required by the director
Both the project/director and the student must individually reach a minimum of 60 out of 100 points to compete

Two of the 20 scholarships are reserved, one for a combination from the Licenciatura en Enfermeria and one for a combination from the Escuela de Tecnicos Asistenciales en Salud, provided the 60-point minimum is met
Each director may submit a single project; co-directors are allowed if justified and cannot act as directors in the same call
requirements: Send the completed ANEXO 3 model note by email to the Direccion de Investigacion y Relaciones Institucionales (dir_investigacion@fcm.uncu.edu.ar) with copy to the Secretaria de Desarrollo Institucional (desarrolloinstitucional@fcm.uncu.edu.ar) between 9 and 20 November 2026
Attach a Curriculum Vitae with its respective probanzas and the certificado analitico including aplazos
In individual mode, select up to 20 eligible projects/directors from the published list; the selection is not a preference order and every project listed is treated as an acceptable assignment
In dupla mode, the student and the director must identify each other reciprocally in ANEXO 3 and ANEXO 1 within the registration deadline
Complete the 10-hour Research Methodology course and 200 hours of project execution within a maximum of six consecutive months
Complete the compulsory in-person oral defence of the final report at the Jornada Final and submit the mandatory extended abstract for the Revista Medica Universitaria
documents: ANEXO 3 model note (student registration form for the Segunda Etapa)
Curriculum Vitae with its respective supporting evidence (probanzas)
Certificado analitico (official academic transcript), including aplazos
For dupla applications, the reciprocal ANEXO 1 submitted by the project director
selection_criteria: Project/director scored out of 100: director antecedents 40 points (teaching background 5, publications in the last five years 15, congress presentations 5, other relevant background 5, young teacher-researcher aged 45 or under 5, co-director from a different career or cycle 5), originality and relevance to health problems 10, clarity of the problem statement 10, clarity of hypothesis and objectives 10, appropriateness of materials and methods 10, formative relevance for the student 10, feasibility 10

Student antecedents scored out of 100: general average including aplazos 65 points, plus 5 points each for approved courses outside the compulsory curriculum, courses without assessment, attendance at congresses, university extension activities, university teaching, presentations at congresses and full-article publications, and scholarships, prizes and distinctions
Final score of each combination = project/director score + student score, maximum 200 points; all combinations, in dupla or individual, enter one single merit order
If two combinations tie, the one with the higher student score prevails; if the tie persists, a documented draw is held by the Comision Asesora
Neither modality gives priority, a reserved place or extra points, and renewals or prior working relationships earn no automatic continuity
coverage: A one-off payment of $151.637,14 per scholarship, paid 70% at the start of the project and 30% on completion against the director's report
Insurance costs of the scholarship holder, covered by the Faculty
210 clock hours of training: the 10-hour Research Methodology course (1-5 February 2027) and 200 hours of project execution (from 8 February 2027)
The payment is exclusively for the student as support for their research training and does not have to be repaid
Funds may not be used for the directors or for the project's operating costs; the inputs, materials and other resources needed for the research must be provided by the project direction
Tuition, living costs, travel and installation costs are not covered by this scholarship
application_method: First stage: FCM teacher-researchers submit their antecedents and an abbreviated research project (ANEXO 1 and ANEXO 2) by email to the Direccion de Investigacion y Relaciones Institucionales with copy to the Secretaria de Desarrollo Institucional, from 5 to 16 October 2026
The Comision Asesora evaluates the submitted projects (19-30 October 2026) against the ANEXO 2 grid
Admitted projects and directors are published with each director's availability schedule from 2 to 6 November 2026
Second stage: students register individually or in dupla by sending the ANEXO 3 model note with CV, probanzas and certificado analitico, from 9 to 20 November 2026
Student antecedents are evaluated (30 November to 11 December 2026) against the ANEXO 4 grid and combinations are ranked on the combined score out of 200
Provisional assignments are notified, students confirm acceptance and definitive awards are published between 14 and 18 December 2026; scholarships begin on 1 February 2027
official.application_route: By email only: send the ANEXO 3 model note with CV, probanzas and certificado analitico to dir_investigacion@fcm.uncu.edu.ar, copy to desarrolloinstitucional@fcm.uncu.edu.ar, during 9-20 November 2026; there is no online application portal
official.study_mode: Not published as full-time or part-time; students must be available on the days and hours required by the project director, and the bases state that presence may be required
official.citizenship_residency: No citizenship, nationality or residency rule is published; eligibility is defined by being a regular student of Medicina, Licenciatura en Enfermeria or Tecnicos Asistenciales en Salud at the FCM UNCUYO who has passed the first complete year
official.international_eligibility: No nationality clause is published, so enrolment status is the only gate: any regular student of the eligible FCM UNCUYO degrees, including foreign nationals enrolled there, may apply provided the first full year has been passed
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Restricted to students of Medicina, Licenciatura en Enfermeria and Tecnicos Asistenciales en Salud at the FCM UNCUYO. The research project must fall within one of the published health research categories: basic and biomedical research; clinical research; epidemiological and population health research; research on health systems, services and policies; translational and implementation research; research on innovation, technologies and technology transfer in health; and research on education in the health sciences
official.research_requirement: Students do not write a research proposal: they apply to projects already submitted by FCM teacher-researchers and admitted in the first stage, and must be able to carry out 200 hours of project execution under that director
official.duration: 210 clock hours in total: 10 hours for the Research Methodology course (1-5 February 2027) and 200 hours for project execution (from 8 February 2027), over a maximum of six consecutive months
official.description: An initiative of the Direccion de Investigacion y Relaciones Institucionales of the Secretaria de Desarrollo Institucional, presented by the FCM UNCUYO to promote the scientific training of undergraduate and pre-graduate students by bringing them into the Faculty's research projects and teams. The Faculty frames the award as formative: selected students work alongside teacher-researchers and acquire tools for formulating hypotheses and objectives, methodological planning, research ethics, results analysis and the oral and written presentation of scientific work, rather than being assessed on a finished project.
official.program_type: Undergraduate research scholarship (becas de investigacion para estudiantes de grado y pregrado)

tuition_coverage_note: no published wording about tuition exists, as this is a research stipend rather than a degree scholarship
living, travel and installation allowances: no such items are published, so they are recorded as not covered rather than estimated
verification.notes: The amount was read directly from the official Bases PDF of the Convocatoria 2026-2027 (section DURACION Y MONTO DE LAS BECAS), which publishes 20 scholarships for $151.637,14 each; the document names no currency, and '$' on this Argentine official university document denotes Argentine pesos (ARS). Deadlines, the 210-hour structure, the two-stage mechanism and the evaluation grids were cross-checked against the two official FCM announcement pages, and the bases category page carries no extension or amendment notice.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a 20-place, faculty-internal research scholarship that pays ARS 151.637,14 in total, released 70% in February 2027 and the remaining 30% only after the project director files an approved closing report. You do not bring your own topic: an FCM teacher-researcher had to get a project through the first stage that closed on 16 October 2026, and you then choose from the list of admitted projects published 2-6 November 2026. Ranking runs on the combined project-plus-student score out of 200, so pairing a well-scoring project with a strong, well-evidenced transcript matters far more than the number of projects you tick. There is no tuition, living-cost or travel element, so treat this as structured research training with a modest stipend rather than a funded place.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Medicine, Nursing and health-technician students at the FCM UNCUYO who have finished their first year, hold a solid average with few aplazos and want a supervised first research project without having to bring their own supervisor.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you are a regular student of Medicina, Licenciatura en Enfermeria or Tecnicos Asistenciales en Salud and that your first complete year is fully approved before the 20 November 2026 registration window closes.

Request the official certificado analitico including aplazos well in advance: the average item alone carries 65 of the 100 student points and is verified by the Direccion de Investigacion with the Departamento de Alumnos.
Collect an individual probanza for every CV item you claim (congress attendance, extension activities, non-obligatory courses, publications, prizes), because unproven antecedents score zero.
Download ANEXO 3 from the official Bases page and draft the model note listing only projects you would genuinely accept, since every listed project becomes a binding combination.
Track the 2-6 November 2026 diffusion window and shortlist projects whose director's declared supervision days, hours and presence requirements fit your academic timetable.
If applying in dupla, confirm in writing that the director filed ANEXO 1 naming you before the 16 October 2026 stage-1 deadline and that you both name the same project.
common_rejection_risks: Scoring below 60/100 on either side of the combination: a brilliant student attached to a weak project, or the reverse, knocks the whole pairing out regardless of the combined total.
Claiming antecedents without probanzas. The grid only counts documented items, so an impressive but unevidenced CV contributes little beyond the transcript average.

A dupla that is not reciprocal. The director must name the student in ANEXO 1 and the student must name the same project in ANEXO 3; a one-sided nomination either fails or falls back to a weaker individual bid.
In individual mode, listing projects you would not actually accept. All listed projects are treated as acceptable assignments and there is no later stage in which to choose a director by score.

Ignoring the closing obligations. Missing the compulsory in-person oral defence or failing to submit the extended abstract for the Revista Medica Universitaria leaves the scholarship academically incomplete and blocks final certification.
Overcommitting. The bases explicitly advise students who cannot guarantee active, sustained participation across 200 hours in six consecutive months to reconsider applying.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition, living costs, travel and research consumables. Only the fixed stipend and your insurance are covered, and the bases state that the inputs, materials and other resources needed to run the project must be supplied by the project director. Work is largely on site at the director's laboratory, hospital or institute in Mendoza, so local transport, materials and the February-June 2027 time commitment sit with you.
document_audit: The certificado analitico must be the official transcript and must include aplazos; an unofficial printout will not evidence the 65-point average item, which is cross-checked against departmental records.
Probanzas must be attached individually for each CV claim. ANEXO 3 is a declaracion jurada, so any inaccuracy is explicit grounds for exclusion from the programme.
In dupla mode both ANEXO 1 (director) and ANEXO 3 (student) must exist and match each other; verify the director actually filed theirs before the stage-1 deadline.

Everything travels by institutional email to dir_investigacion@fcm.uncu.edu.ar with copy to desarrolloinstitucional@fcm.uncu.edu.ar and there is no upload portal, so keep the sent message as proof of timely submission.

The 65 points for the average are capped at the highest average achieved in the last five years, which the Direccion requests from the Departamento de Alumnos, so an exceptional average may not score the full 65.
alerts: The 20 November 2026 student deadline is only reachable if you waited for the 2-6 November 2026 publication of admitted projects; there is nothing to apply to before that.
Stage 1 closed on 16 October 2026, so from now on your options are fixed to the projects that already cleared that stage, with no new projects accepted later.
Initial assignments are PROVISIONAL until the confirmation and recalculation step of 14-18 December 2026; desistements on either side can move you into or out of the 20 places.
The scholarship starts 1 February 2027 with the methodology course 1-5 February, so plan academic or work leave for February to June 2027, including the summer months some directors may use.
The closing oral defence (14-18 June 2027) is in person and compulsory; an unjustified absence prevents final certification even though most of the stipend has already been paid.
An aval academico carries the identical workload, follow-up obligations and closing requirements but pays no stipend at all, so accept one only if the training itself is the goal.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Watch for the published list of admitted projects and directors (2-6 November 2026), complete ANEXO 3 and email it with your CV, probanzas and certificado analitico to the Direccion de Investigacion y Relaciones Institucionales with copy to the Secretaria de Desarrollo Institucional between 9 and 20 November 2026; evaluation runs 30 November to 11 December 2026, provisional assignments are notified 14-18 December 2026, and you must then confirm acceptance of the scholarship.
